title: Elevated Italian Sundried Tomatoes Flatbread
description: A flaky, indulgent flatbread featuring sun-dried tomatoes, perfect for a satisfying dinner. This Italian dish is inspired by the traditional flavors of Lombardy.

ingredients.name: Type "00" flour
ingredients.notes: Use a high-protein flour for flaky crust.

ingredients.name: Dry yeast
ingredients.notes: Active dry yeast is fine, but instant yeast will speed up rising.

ingredients.name: Salt
ingredients.notes: Use sea salt or flaky salt for added flavor.

ingredients.name: Sugar
ingredients.notes: A small amount of sugar helps yeast fermentation.

ingredients.name: Active dry yeast
ingredients.notes: Optional, but highly recommended for authentic flavor.

ingredients.name: Sun-dried tomatoes
ingredients.notes: Mix of cherry and larger tomatoes for depth of flavor.

ingredients.name: Grana Padano cheese
ingredients.notes: Replace with Parmesan or Pecorino for a different flavor profile.

ingredients.name: Fresh basil
ingredients.notes: Chopped fresh basil adds a bright, herbaceous note.

ingredients.name: Kalamata olives
ingredients.notes: Pitted for convenience, but leave some pits for added texture.

ingredients.name: Capers
ingredients.notes: Rinsed and drained to remove excess salt.

ingredients.name: Dried oregano
ingredients.notes: Italian oregano has a more complex flavor profile than Greek oregano.

instructions: Combine flour, salt, sugar, and dry yeast in a large mixing bowl.
Gradually add olive oil, mixing until dough forms.
Knead dough for 10 minutes, until smooth and elastic.
Place dough in a lightly oiled bowl, cover with plastic wrap, and let rise at room temperature for 1 hour.
Preheat oven to 450°F (230°C) with a baking stone or baking sheet inside.
Divide dough into 2-3 equal pieces, depending on desired flatbread size.
Roll out each piece into a thin circle, about 1/8 inch thick.
Transfer dough to preheated stone or baking sheet, leaving space between each flatbread.
Bake for 12-15 minutes, or until crust is golden brown and crispy.
Meanwhile, mix sun-dried tomatoes, Grana Padano cheese, and chopped fresh basil in a small bowl.
Once flatbreads are done, top each with a spoonful of the sun-dried tomato mixture.
Drizzle with extra virgin olive oil and sprinkle with red pepper flakes, if using.
Serve immediately, garnished with additional basil leaves if desired.
